knowledge_graph.title: Winchester Community High School
knowledge_graph.description: Winchester Community High School is a public high school located in Winchester, Indiana, United States. The School serves the town of Winchester and surrounding area. In 2023 the student body was about 93 percent white and 4 percent hispanic.
